land|Game Trail|Molten Slagheap.why: Molten Slagheap taps for colourless; it only makes black or red through storage counters. Game Trail is an untapped red-green dual.

spell|Burnished Hart|Rhythm of the Wild.why: Rhythm (60% of Vaevictis decks) gives every creature Avacyn returns riot, a counter or haste, and makes creature spells uncounterable. Your only copy is in The Ur-Dragon, so it's on the buylist rather than taken.

spell|Champion's Helm|Ichor Wellspring.why: Wellspring is cheap fodder for Vaevictis's self-sacrifice, but the deck already makes fodder every turn (Woe Strider's Goat, Grave Titan's and Gisa's Zombies, Doctor Doom's Doombots), and your copy is in Bartolomé. Helm keeps Vaevictis safe.

spell|Fyndhorn Elves|Sakura-Tribe Elder.why: Sakura-Tribe Elder sacrifices itself for a land and Avacyn returns it every end step: a land every turn. Your copy is in Dina; buylist.

spell|Ghoulcaller Gisa|Lightning Greaves.why: Greaves protects Vaevictis and gives him haste. All three copies are in other decks; buylist.

spell|Massacre Girl, Most Wanted|Swiftfo.why: Boots protects Vaevictis, but all four copies are in other decks, and Champion's Helm already gives him hexproof. Buylist, behind Greaves.

spell|Talisman of Indulgence|Solemn Simu.why: Solemn ramps when it enters and draws when it dies, again every time Avacyn returns it. Your copy is in Y'shtola; buylist.

spell|Wild Growth|Birds of Paradise.why: Birds fixes all three colours. Your copy is in The Ur-Dragon; buylist.
